items.title: A lot of good answers especially on how to play alongside Rudy Gobert.
items.author: Hoop Informatics
items.body_excerpt:
A lot of good answers especially on how to play alongside Rudy Gobert.

But the best one, when asked how freeing it is to have signed a 5-year contract Ayo said it’s just the opposite. He feels more pressure now. They invested in him so he’s locked in & focused. He wants to outplay his new contract.
